what: F8 gate: 22 of 22 counties clickable. In the running app (Streamlit 1.51, Plotly 6.3, pane 1024x768), each county's polygon was hovered then clicked at an interior point, and the County selector was read back.
method: Mouse events dispatched in the page at an interior point of each polygon (SVG isPointInFill); Plotly's own hover hit-test reported the location before the click. Keski-Uusimaa (02), Vantaa-Kerava (04) and Helsinki (90) are clicked in the Helsinki-area inset; the other 19 on the main map. Real mouse clicks (computer tool) were also confirmed for Lappi (21), Varsinais-Suomi (05) and Helsinki (90, inset).
before_fix: Without the inset, 20 of 22: clicks on Vantaa-Kerava selected Keski-Uusimaa and clicks on Helsinki selected Vantaa-Kerava (their interior points were 3-9 px apart at full-map scale).
columns: Plotly hover location at the click point
